title: Lord of the Rings: Books Only
description: Journey through Middle-earth as Tolkien wrote it — no films, no extras, just the pages of The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings trilogy.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the hobbit hole where Bilbo Baggins lives?
questions.explanation: Bilbo Baggins lives at Bag End, Bagshot Row, Hobbiton, as established in the opening of The Hobbit.

questions.prompt: Who is the wizard that recruits Bilbo Baggins for the quest to reclaim Erebor?
questions.explanation: Gandalf arranges Bilbo's participation in the quest to reclaim the Lonely Mountain in Chapter 1 of The Hobbit.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the dragon who occupies the Lonely Mountain?
questions.explanation: Smaug the Tremendous drove the dwarves from Erebor and hoards their treasure, as described in The Hobbit.

questions.prompt: In The Fellowship of the Ring, what is the name of the inn in Bree where Frodo first meets Strider?
questions.explanation: Frodo and his companions meet Aragorn (Strider) at The Prancing Pony inn in Bree in The Fellowship of the Ring.

questions.prompt: What is the elvish name for the forest realm ruled by Galadriel and Celeborn?
questions.explanation: Lothlórien is the golden-wooded realm of Galadriel and Celeborn, visited by the Fellowship in The Fellowship of the Ring.

questions.prompt: What creature does Gollum call the One Ring?
questions.explanation: Gollum obsessively calls the One Ring 'my precious' throughout both The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings.

questions.prompt: Into what volcanic mountain must the One Ring be cast to destroy it?
questions.explanation: The One Ring can only be destroyed in the fires of Mount Doom (Orodruin) in Mordor, as revealed in The Fellowship of the Ring.
